theorem.full_set: for the full retained mode set, inward=outward=0 and the identity reduces to the ordinary viscous Navier-Stokes energy balance
theorem.gross_transfer_anti_theorem: a closed triad wholly inside A can carry arbitrarily rescaled positive internal donor/recipient work while Phi_in=Phi_out=0; the energy stock law is not a finite gross-transfer budget
theorem.internal_flow: F(AxA) is real same-time nonlinear redistribution and cancels exactly from the set divergence; it is neither dissipation nor event depth
theorem.same_time_flow: cyclic donor measure is pushed to physical helical-mode nodes; for mode set A, P_A=I_A+In_A and N_A=I_A+Out_A, hence P_A-N_A=In_A-Out_A
theorem.singleton: for one helical mode m, E_m(t1)+integral W_m^- + 2 nu |k|^2 integral E_m = E_m(s)+integral W_m^+, using gross canonical edge Hahn work, not Hahn of modal net work
theorem.state_ontology: persistent state energy lives on physical helical modes; hard product cells remain interaction labels and are not wallets across time
theorem.temporal_provenance: the identity gives aggregate stock/flow balance only; it does not canonically pair an earlier positive deposit with a later withdrawal and uses no FIFO/LIFO rule
